description: Get recent activity in one course: announcements, discussion replies, grade changes and messages. Read-only. Titles and messages are fenced as untrusted. For all courses at once, use get_activity_stream.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

name: get_course_activity_stream
title: Get Course Activity Stream
